universe.notes: Manufacturer Japan online manual article: five complete and separately enumerated smartphone tables (18+39+8+19+5) = 89 exact marketed models. Sixth 34-row tablet table explicitly excluded. Live CI re-extracted all 89 with 189 official carrier/model support candidates. First-pass 82 direct, 7 title mismatches; independent manufacturer secondary discovery reconciled all 89 as 85 direct manual-index + 4 exact support-only + 0 held. No variant identities inferred from family, and no third-party carrier manual used. Samsung A21 Simple index uses SCG49 while separate official au firmware list uses SCV49; exact シンプル Japanese manual metadata in Samsung product page resolves this inconsistency.
